integrity: Proof uses the exact Toeplitz Schur complement, a nonnegative-square inequality, full contact-set classification, positive Haar John certificate, and exact fiber-volume integration. Finite checker output corroborates but does not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-dimensional degree-two universal Carathéodory orbitope only; no higher-degree classification. General minimum-volume orbit-enclosing ellipsoid theorem of Barvinok and Blekherman credited as prior, not a new conclusion. Unindexed historical priority remains a risk.
title: The sharp John contact circle of the four-dimensional Carathéodory orbitope
